address: 15 Soi Ekkamai 10, Khlong Tan Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Khao presents delightful Thai cuisine in a beautiful dining space that is inspired by traditional rice barns. The menu is all about attention to detail, using premium ingredients and blending diverse flavours that cater to every palate. Whether for casual dining or business meetings, it's an ideal spot to experience a thoughtfully curated meal that stays true to the essence of Thai cuisine. Book the Chef's Table menu for an exquisite culinary journey....
